objective: Turn the existing SovereignMind repository into one verified, judge-legible Flare Summer Signal candidate centered on an FXRP Treasury Guard; do not guarantee a win.

clarification_policy.ask_only_when: A missing answer materially changes eligibility, user authority, external side effects, paid spend, private data, or irreversible scope.
clarification_policy.otherwise: Make the narrowest reversible assumption, label it, continue, and schedule the fastest falsification test.

authorized_without_new_approval: read current official public event sources
read public Flare documentation and contracts
write and edit Flare-related files inside this workspace
run local builds, tests, live read-only Coston2 checks, and deterministic validators
prepare local demo and submission artifacts that are not sent externally
create a scoped local Git commit containing only Flare Summer Signal work
requires_explicit_user_authorization: register for an event or create an external account
purchase services, credits, domains, hardware, or paid assets
sign or broadcast a Coston2 deployment or other wallet transaction
use private data, credentials, or production systems
accept legal terms or represent the user to organizers

defaults.candidate_count: one existing project with one event-period Flare extension
defaults.product_scope: one FXRP treasury operator, one exposure-policy decision, one human approval receipt
defaults.implementation_shape: Coston2 contracts plus the existing Next.js web surface
defaults.evaluation: official rubric with observed evidence and explicit proof limits
defaults.delivery_reserve: protect 30 percent of verified capacity for integration, proof, demo, and submission
defaults.execution: run only bounded local workplan commands and retain hashed receipts
defaults.progress_reporting: phase, evidence gained, blocker, and next gate

cycle: keep, cut, narrow, pivot, or stop decision
stop_conditions: critical mechanism fails its threshold twice
remaining work cannot fit the build and evidence window
candidate passes the applicable frozen submission gate
an external deployment or submission action is the only remaining gate

admit_only_for: submission thumbnail required by the event
prohibited: fake product screenshot or nonexistent feature
undisclosed synthetic user, result, endorsement, or evidence
copied brand, winner trade dress, or unlicensed style imitation
asset work that delays the flagship loop or proof gate
